== Summary ==
Original Players Committee Virtual slip: •Han's Heavy Blaster Pistol (V), from the Virtual Set #1 sheet hosted by Decipher (PDF made 6 March 2002; tournament-legal 9 March 2002). Page 1, left column, row 4, slip “4”. Old pre-template slip (before the Players Committee remastered the set in December 2006). Cropped unchanged from a 300 dpi render of the PDF page (no retouching).

Source: https://web.archive.org/web/20050813215254/http://decipher.com/starwars/cardlists/virtual/VirtualCards1.pdf#page=1

archive.org copy of this exact original (SHA-1 checked by archive.org): [https://archive.org/download/swccg-wiki-images-8/8f/VS1-20020306-4-Han_s_Heavy_Blaster_Pistol.png Internet Archive item].
